title: Top Customer Questions & Answers
content:
Business Name: RoSin Bangles / RoSin Jewellery

Topic: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Q1: How do I order a customized set?
A: Send your outfit picture and preferred design via WhatsApp at +91 8438990370 or Instagram DM @rosin_bangles. Once confirmed and paid, RoSin will craft and dispatch your order.

Q2: Are kids sizes available?
A: Yes, bangles for children are available under the Kids collection.

Q3: How do I check my bangle size?
A: Refer to the size guide: 2.4 is 6.0 cm, 2.6 is 6.3–6.5 cm, and 2.8 is 6.7 cm. Measure your hand or an existing well-fitting bangle before ordering.

Q4: Do you have imitation jewellery for rent?
A: Yes, bridal imitation jewellery rentals are available. Visit the store in Pallipalayam or message WhatsApp (+91 8438990370).

Q5: Do you have express shipping for urgent orders?
A: Yes. Contact WhatsApp (+91 8438990370) directly with your required date and location for express dispatch assistance.

Q6: Do you ship internationally?
A: Yes, RoSin ships worldwide (1–2 weeks delivery). International orders are booked via WhatsApp (+91 8438990370). Customs charges are payable by the customer.

Q7: What is your return policy?
A: All items are made to order, so RoSin does not accept returns, exchanges, or refunds. For transit damage claims, an uncut 360-degree unboxing video must be submitted to WhatsApp within 2 days of delivery.

title: No Return Policy, Unboxing Video Requirement & Breakage Allowance
content:
Business Name: RoSin Bangles / RoSin Jewellery

Topic: Return, Refund & Exchange Policy

Strict No Return / No Refund / No Exchange Policy:
- All jewellery items are custom made to order. RoSin does not provide exchange, return, or refund under normal circumstances.
- No size exchange: Customers must check the size guide before ordering. Size exchanges or returns are strictly not accepted.

Transit Damage & Missing Items:
- Customers must notify RoSin via WhatsApp (+91 8438990370) within 2 days (maximum 3 days) of receiving the parcel.
- An uncut, continuous 360-degree unboxing video displaying all sides of the parcel and the shipping label before opening is mandatory. Without an unboxing video, no claim will be processed.
- Glass bangle breakage: 1 or 2 broken glass bangles is considered normal transit wear and is beyond control (no claim). If more than 6 glass bangles are broken, contact RoSin immediately with the unboxing video for review.
- Handmade variations: Slight handcrafted variations or minor stone loosening from transit are natural for handmade items and not considered manufacturing defects.

Product Care Instructions:
- Delicate bangles and handmade items are not designed for daily rough wear.
- Keep bangles away from soap and water. Remove before bathing or hand washing to avoid color fading or damage.

title: Handmade Craft Time, Domestic & International Shipping
content:
Business Name: RoSin Bangles / RoSin Jewellery

Topic: Shipping & Delivery Policy

Production & Handcrafting Times:
- Handmade items: All handmade items are made to order. It takes 7 to 10 business days to handcraft the jewellery before dispatch.
- Glass bangles: Dispatch takes 5 to 20 business days depending on ready stock availability. If ready stock is available, dispatch is immediate; otherwise, it takes up to 20 days as a pre-order.

Domestic Delivery (India):
- Domestic delivery within India takes 3 to 10 business days from the date of dispatch.
- Shipping charges are calculated based on parcel weight and delivery location, specified at checkout.
- Urgent orders / express dispatch: Available upon request by contacting WhatsApp at +91 8438990370.

International Delivery:
- RoSin ships internationally worldwide. International delivery typically takes 1 to 2 weeks.
- International orders must be placed directly by contacting WhatsApp (+91 8438990370) or Instagram DM (@rosin_bangles).
- Customs fees, import duties, and local taxes are the sole responsibility of the customer.

Order Tracking:
- Tracking details are sent via email and text message once dispatched.
- RoSin is not responsible for courier delays. If a parcel is not delivered within 15 days of dispatch, contact rosinfashionjewellery@gmail.com.
